description: Branches open on Mondays, all day. A before-4am window can be missed for weeks, and the weekly lock refresh is how patched transitive versions arrive.

packageRules.description: Dev tooling merges itself once every check on the branch passes: Lint & Test runs prek and the tests on these changes, and none of them ships to the Pi. A week's wait first gives a hijacked release time to be yanked. Runtime dependencies, Docker images and lock refreshes stay manual, since CI cannot run the camera. Renovate merges these itself (platformAutomerge off) because main requires an approval that only Renovate's ruleset bypass skips.
uv_build is the build backend: uv sync --locked builds the project with it in Lint & Test, so it merges itself like the tooling above.
picamera2 in Debian Trixie is a CPython 3.13 build; the runtime image and requires-python have to match it
